EN: Like many of his kin, Fflammych was born and raised amidst the rivalry between {GLOBAL.GiantsLoreConcept.Hyperlink} and {GLOBAL.DragonsLoreConcept.Hyperlink}. As the guardian of his hearth, Fflammych has seen many a battle and has always protected his kin and people with fire and blood. Recently, however, revelations of greater dangers than Dragons have dimmed the vengeance in his heart. Some say he even dares to question the ancient rivalries.[br/][br/]Fflammych's Hearthkin believe their {GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept.Hyperlink} are forged in the heart of their Giant King, and thus they follow Fflammych with unwavering loyalty. Alguns dizem que ele ousa até questionar as rivalidades antigas.[br/][br/]Os Hearthkin de Fflammych acreditam que seus {GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept.Hyperlink} são forjados no coração de seu Rei Gigante, e por isso seguem Fflammych com lealdade inabalável.
